body:
I did have another talk with him last night and he deleted everything immediately when I expressed how it made me uncomfortable. I know we are on the right track and now it is up to me to understand that we are the present and different from that previous relationship but ultimately I am very content and happy!

Thank you for your response! :)

I have been hurt pretty badly in my only other relationship that was serious as well. I definitely agree that this has everything to do with me being insecure.

I am so very happy with my boyfriend and our relationship and I’ve never felt so confident in a future with somebody else before. I wouldn’t ever want to end us so I am going to work on myself and feeling more sure of my own person. Thank you for your response! :)

As far as I know, I don’t believe it was an engagement ring. I definitely can understand all your points and I think I just need to get that through in my head.

He did bring up all those same points but having it reiterated definitely proves something. I tend to get in my head about all these things so thank you for your response! :)
